redhead.definition:
n. someone who has red hair
n. North American diving duck with a grey-and-black body and reddish-brown head

redheaded.definition: s. having red hair and usually fair skin
redheaded.translation: a. 红发的, 红头羽毛的

redheads.definition:
n. someone who has red hair
n. North American diving duck with a grey-and-black body and reddish-brown head
n. black-and-white North American woodpecker having a red head and neck
redheads.translation: n. 红发的人( redhead的复数形式 ); 红头啄木鸟

redhibition.definition:
n. The annulling of a sale, and the return by the buyer
   of the article sold, on account of some defect.
redhibition.translation: n. 买卖无效, 原货退回

redhibitory action.translation: [法] 因货物有瑕疵要求解除契约的诉讼

redhorse.translation: [网络] 小红马；叠罗汉；红马酒店
